q: A coach compares video with runners' split times. The comparison sheds light on why a handover failed, although one camera angle is missing. What does the expression say the comparison achieves?
o: It keeps the cause of the failed handover hidden from view.
It helps explain the failure despite a gap in the evidence.
It physically brightens the track where the runners compete.
It proves the cause even without any supporting information.

exp.trans: 教练将视频与运动员的分段用时比较。尽管缺少一个拍摄角度，这种比较仍帮助解释交接为什么失败。该表达说明比较起到什么作用？
exp.structure: The comparison是主语；sheds light on后接why引导的解释对象；although保留信息仍不完整这一限定。
exp.other: split time分段用时；handover交接；camera angle拍摄角度；settle确定解决。
exp.meaning: shed light on是帮助说明、使更清楚，方向与隐藏相反；部分解释可以成立，不等于所有细节已经证实。
exp.rest: keeps...hidden把阐明反转为遮蔽；physically brightens把固定短语硬译为照明；proves...without information把帮助理解夸大成无证据也能证明。

target: bring to light / shed light on
skill: bring to light / shed light on
q: An audit brings an unrecorded payment to light. A later analysis sheds light on how it bypassed checks. Which reading preserves the different emphases?
o: The audit hides the payment; the analysis also conceals the process.
The audit explains the process; the analysis denies any payment existed.
The audit illuminates a room; the analysis changes its lighting system.
The audit reveals the payment; the analysis helps explain the process.

exp.trans: 审计揭露了一笔未入账的款项；后续分析帮助说明它如何绕过检查。怎样理解才能保留两种表达的侧重点？
exp.structure: brings...to light的宾语是先前未知的payment；sheds light on的对象是how引导的运作过程。
exp.meaning: bring to light偏使隐情为人所知；shed light on偏提供理解所需的信息。这里可以前者揭露事实、后者解释机制，不必强行互斥。
exp.rest: hides和conceals均反转方向；denies payment没有依据且否认已揭露事实；room/lighting system把两个比喻都误作物理照明。

q: Every autumn this tree sheds its leaves beside the shed. Which reading preserves the two uses of shed?
o: The tree loses leaves; the noun names a small storage building.
The tree hides leaves; the noun names shade from direct sunlight.
The tree guards leaves; the noun means protection from bad weather.
The tree emits light; the noun names a clearing exposed to sunlight.

exp.trans: 每年秋天，这棵树在棚屋旁落叶。如何理解才保留了shed的两种用法？
exp.structure: tree是主语，sheds是谓语，leaves是宾语；介词beside后的the shed是名词短语。词性由句法位置区分。
exp.meaning: 名词shed指小型储物棚屋，用户这一记忆本来正确；动词shed在leaves语境指脱落，不能把名词义套进谓语。
exp.rest: hides反转落叶动作且把名词当成shade；guards既非落叶又把shed当shelter；emits light虽可能是shed的另一动词搭配，却不适用于宾语leaves。

q: During a storm, walkers take shelter in a railway waiting room. Which meaning of shelter is relevant?
o: A small building intended primarily for keeping garden tools.
An area made darker only by blocking direct rays of sunlight.
Protection from bad weather, here provided by a waiting room.
The release of leaves from a tree during a seasonal change.

exp.trans: 暴风雨中，行人在铁路候车室避雨。shelter在这里对应什么含义？
exp.structure: take shelter表示寻求庇护；in a railway waiting room指出提供庇护的场所；during a storm给出需要保护的背景。
exp.other: walker步行者；waiting room候车室；primarily主要地；seasonal季节性的。
exp.meaning: shelter强调免受风雨或危险的庇护，既可说功能也可指场所；这里不要求该场所是专用避难建筑。
exp.rest: keeping tools描述shed常见名词义，却不是此处的保护功能；blocking sunlight只说明shade的遮阳方向；release of leaves是动词shed的另一语境。

target: shade does not guarantee rain protection
skill: shade does not guarantee rain protection
q: A slatted cover shades a reading area at noon, but rain still passes through its gaps. What does shades indicate here?
o: Seals every gap so rain can no longer reach people underneath.
Blocks direct sunlight without necessarily keeping the rain out.
Turns the reading area into an enclosed building for tool storage.
Releases enough light to make the whole reading area much brighter.

exp.trans: 条板顶棚在中午为阅读区遮阳，但雨仍能从缝隙穿过。shades在这里表明什么？
exp.structure: shades是cover所做的动作；but把遮阳与不能完全挡雨并列对照，不能只保留有保护作用的宽泛印象。
exp.other: slatted由条板构成的；gap缝隙；underneath在下方；enclosed封闭的。
exp.meaning: shade在这里遮挡直射阳光。某些东西同时遮阳避雨是可能的，但此处遮阳不保证挡雨，须保留后半句限制。
exp.rest: Seals every gap与雨能穿过直接冲突；tool storage无依据地把功能改成shed；Releases light是散发光线，方向与遮挡相反。

q: A desk lamp sheds a warm glow while a screen shades the window. Which reading fits both verbs?
o: The lamp stores tools; the screen emits sunlight into the room.
The lamp hides its light; the screen creates a new storage shed.
The lamp loses its leaves; the screen provides a storm forecast.
The lamp gives off light; the screen blocks some incoming sunlight.

exp.trans: 台灯散发柔和光线，窗屏则遮挡窗外的光。哪种理解符合两个动词？
exp.structure: lamp与screen分别是两个动作主体；shed的宾语glow指实际光线，此处是散发义；shade的宾语window表明遮光。
exp.other: desk lamp台灯；glow柔和光线；give off散发；incoming进入的。
exp.meaning: shed可按宾语表示散发光等，shade在这里是遮光；字形相近不等于方向相同。此处也不要将字面发光一概替换为shed light on的阐明义。
exp.rest: stores tools把名词棚屋硬套进动词；hides反转发光；loses leaves忽略实际宾语glow；窗屏发光、建棚或预报天气也不符合原句。

q: A translation collective has completed its first small commission and is still learning how to work together. A reviewer calls it a budding enterprise. Which expectation fits?
o: It has already reached a stable and fully developed operating scale.
Its first commission proves that every future project must succeed.
It is showing early promise while its organisation is still developing.
It has permanently stopped operating before completing any project.

exp.trans: 一个翻译合作团队刚完成首个小委托，成员仍在学习协作。评论者称它为budding enterprise。怎样理解适当？
exp.structure: first small commission与still learning共同限定发展阶段；budding修饰enterprise，评价的是事业的初期发展。
exp.other: collective合作团队；commission委托；enterprise事业、企业；promise潜力。
exp.meaning: budding表示萌芽、开始显现潜力，不等于充分成熟；积极预期也不能推出每个项目必定成功。
exp.rest: fully developed把初期推成成熟；every future...must夸大确定性；permanently stopped与已完成委托并继续学习不符。

q: Two neighbours have begun sharing meals after years of merely exchanging greetings. The narrator describes a budding friendship. What is established?
o: A closer relationship is beginning, though its future remains open.
A lifelong friendship is already certain to survive every difficulty.
Their earlier greetings prove that they have always been close friends.
The relationship has ended because the neighbours avoid one another.

exp.trans: 两位邻居多年只是打招呼，最近开始一起吃饭，叙述者称之为budding friendship。能确认什么？
exp.structure: have begun标记变化开始；after years of merely...对比原先较疏远的状态；budding概括关系正萌芽。
exp.meaning: 是更亲密关系的开端，而非已经充分确立的终生承诺。发展初期、已有发展和最终稳定要区分。
exp.rest: lifelong...certain是无依据保证；always close抹去先前只打招呼的限定；has ended与开始一起吃饭的动作相反。

q: A photography jury judges each entry for originality and clarity. Its notice calls these the selection criteria. What are the criteria?
o: The two photographers chosen to sit on the selection panel.
The standards used to judge the submitted photographs.
The photographs that have already won the final prizes.
The ceremonies at which prizes are given to photographers.

exp.trans: 摄影评委按原创性和清晰度评判作品，通知称二者为selection criteria。criteria指什么？
exp.structure: for originality and clarity列出评价维度；these回指这两种标准；criteria是criterion的复数。
exp.other: jury评审团；entry参评作品；originality原创性；clarity清晰度。
exp.meaning: criteria是判断所用的多项标准，不是参加评价的人或评价产生的结果。
exp.rest: photographers把标准当成人；photographs...won把标准当成获奖对象；ceremonies把标准当成颁奖活动。

q: A panel has removed every rule except one. Which revision is standard formal English?
o: Only one criteria remain.
Only one criteria remains.
Only one criterion remain.
Only one criterion remains.

exp.trans: 评审组已删去其余规则，只剩一条。哪种改写符合规范的正式英语？
exp.structure: one要求单数名词criterion；名词作主语时，单数主语对应remains；criteria是复数形式。
exp.other: panel评审组；except除外；formal English正式英语；agreement主谓一致。
exp.meaning: 单数criterion与复数criteria同时影响名词选择和谓语一致，不能只记中文标准而忽略数量。
exp.rest: criteria remain用于复数情形，不能跟one；criteria remains混用复数名词与单数谓语；criterion remain则缺少单数谓语形式。

target: be the envy of / envy direction
skill: be the envy of / envy direction
q: A town library has a free recording studio that neighbouring libraries wish they had. A magazine calls it the envy of the district. Who envies whom?
o: Other libraries wish they had the town library's recording facility.
The town library wishes it could copy the district's existing studio.
The magazine proves that every library dislikes recording facilities.
The town library must remove its studio to satisfy the other libraries.

exp.trans: 一家镇图书馆有免费录音室，周边图书馆也想拥有。杂志称它为the envy of the district。羡慕的方向是什么？
exp.structure: that...wish they had说明他人希望也有该设施；be the envy of中主语是被羡慕的对象。
exp.other: recording studio录音室；neighbouring邻近的；district地区；facility设施。
exp.meaning: the envy of不是主语去羡慕别人，而是别人羡慕主语所拥有的东西。
exp.rest: town library wishes倒置羡慕方向；every...dislikes把羡慕改成厌恶并过度概括；must remove添加不受支持的义务或行动。

q: After months of working beside noisy machinery, a painter says, "I envy Nora her quiet studio." Which paraphrase fits?
o: Nora wishes she could work beside the same noisy machinery.
The painter wants Nora to lose every advantage of her studio.
The painter wishes for the quiet working conditions Nora has.
Nora has asked the painter to find a quiet studio for a friend.

exp.trans: 在嘈杂机器旁工作数月后，画家说：“我羡慕Nora拥有安静的画室。”哪种改写合适？
exp.structure: I是感受羡慕者；Nora是被羡慕的人，her quiet studio说明被羡慕的优势。
exp.other: machinery机器设备；painter画家；working conditions工作条件。
exp.meaning: envy可表示希望自己也拥有他人的某种有利条件；仅有羡慕不必推出恶意或要求对方失去优势。
exp.rest: Nora wishes交换感受者；wants Nora to lose添加恶意行动；has asked...没有原文依据。

q: An archivist is sorting reports under the heading Brexit negotiations. Which subject belongs under that heading?
o: Changes in the route taken by storms crossing the British coast.
Plans to move British residents between two neighbouring counties.
Britain's decision to leave an international military alliance.
Terms of the United Kingdom's withdrawal from the European Union.

exp.trans: 档案员按“Brexit谈判”分类报告。什么主题应归入这一标题？
exp.structure: Brexit作名词修饰negotiations，限定谈判围绕英国退出欧盟；不能只见British就把任何英国话题归进来。
exp.meaning: Brexit专指英国脱欧，不泛指所有英国政治议题或退出任何国际组织。这里检验背景专名，不要求额外历史日期。
exp.rest: storms是天气；between counties是国内搬迁；military alliance虽也涉及国际关系，却不是European Union这一指定组织。

q: A translator renders Brexit as "all European countries leaving Europe." Which correction keeps the term's actual reference?
o: It concerns every European country ending its national elections.
It concerns the United Kingdom's withdrawal from the European Union.
It concerns all members leaving an international military alliance.
It concerns Britain becoming geographically detached from Europe.

exp.trans: 译者把Brexit译成“所有欧洲国家离开欧洲”。怎样纠正才能保留其实际指向？
exp.structure: 须分别核对动作主体United Kingdom和退出对象European Union；Europe的地理范围不等于欧盟这一组织。
exp.other: render翻译为；reference指向；institution机构、制度；geographically在地理上。
exp.meaning: 指英国退出欧盟，而非欧洲各国搬离欧洲大陆。无需凭这个词补造对用户政治背景知识的其他诊断。
exp.rest: every country扩大主体；military alliance替换组织；geographically detached把政治退出误成地理移动。

q: Losing its only rehearsal room dealt a sharp hit to the choir's preparations, though rehearsals continued elsewhere. What does sharp hit describe?
o: A literal blow delivered with a tool that had a sharpened edge.
A slight improvement in the quality of the choir's preparations.
A serious disruption without implying that all activity stopped.
A final cancellation of every rehearsal and every public performance.

exp.trans: 失去唯一排练室给合唱团的准备工作造成严重冲击，但排练仍在别处继续。sharp hit表示什么？
exp.structure: dealt...to...建立事件对准备工作的不利影响；though限制严重冲击不等于所有活动都终止。
exp.other: rehearsal排练；choir合唱团；disruption扰乱；deliver a blow造成打击。
exp.meaning: 这里hit是不利冲击，sharp加重程度；抽象语境不能套成锋利工具的击打，也不能擅自扩大为完全停摆。
exp.rest: literal blow把比喻硬译为物理动作；improvement反转影响方向；final cancellation忽略排练继续这一明确限定。

q: When a venue lost its accessible entrance, advance bookings took a sharp hit. The writer is describing the effect on reservations, not an injury. Which reading fits?
o: Bookings suffered a substantial setback after access was reduced.
A sharp object damaged the paper used to record the reservations.
Reservations rose suddenly because the new entrance was easier to use.
All bookings became permanently impossible at every venue in the city.

exp.trans: 场馆失去无障碍入口后，预订受到严重冲击。作者描述的是对预约的影响，并非身体受伤。如何理解？
exp.structure: When给出背景改变；bookings是受到影响的对象；took a hit表示遭受不利影响，sharp描述冲击程度。
exp.other: venue场馆；accessible entrance无障碍入口；advance booking提前预订；setback挫折。
exp.meaning: 把完整搭配与受影响对象结合，理解为预订遭受明显挫折，而非逐词拼成尖锐物体击打。
exp.rest: sharp object与reservations的抽象对象不符；rose和easier同时反转原文方向；all/every/permanently从单一场馆的严重影响扩大为全城永久不可能。

q: A student crushes an unfinished clay cup and uses the same soft material to remold it into a flat tile. What changes?
o: The original cup is restored without changing its previous form.
The material is given a different shape rather than kept as a cup.
The student replaces clay with a completely different raw material.
The tile is only renamed while retaining the old cup's exact shape.

exp.trans: 学生把未完成的陶杯压碎，用同样的软泥将其重新塑成平板。发生了什么变化？
exp.structure: same soft material保留材料；remold...into...改变其形态；from cup to flat tile说明不是修回原来的杯形。
exp.other: clay黏土；unfinished未完成的；tile平板、瓷砖；retain保留。
exp.meaning: remold可指把软材料重新塑形；re-表示再次，mold表示塑造。材料相同与形状改变可以同时成立。
exp.rest: restored...previous form把重塑当成原样恢复；different raw material否认same；only renamed则抹去形状变化。

q: A youth orchestra remolds its training: individual competitions give way to shared rehearsals and peer feedback. What does remolds mean?
o: It keeps the old training unchanged but announces a new name.
It records the old methods without changing any training practice.
It repairs the building but leaves training methods unchanged.
It reshapes training methods through collaboration and peer feedback.

exp.trans: 青年乐团重塑训练方式：个人竞赛让位于共同排练和同伴反馈。remolds是什么意思？
exp.structure: 冒号后列出训练机制的改变；give way to说明旧方式让位给新方式；动词宾语training是抽象对象。
exp.other: orchestra管弦乐团；peer feedback同伴反馈；give way to让位于；organise组织。
exp.meaning: remold在抽象语境指重新塑造模式，不要求真的使用模具，也不只是改名或修理建筑。
exp.rest: unchanged...new name和records...without changing都否定了实际方法调整；repairs the building把训练模式偷换成物理建筑。
